# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser bubble shooter titled `RaptorCam: Amber Panic`. Preserve the mechanic loop exactly: an 8-column odd-row hex grid, 12 visible rows, a bottom-center launcher, drag/touch aiming clamped upward, release-to-fire projectile, side-wall bounce, ceiling/contact snap, BFS same-color matching at 3 or more, roof-connected floating-cluster checks, 10 points per matched pod, 20 points per dropped pod, low-row warning, row-based game over, empty-grid board reset, start/restart/mute UI.

Rebuild the presentation as a dramatic Jurassic-inspired live-stream paddock. The focal identity is RexByte, a raptor streamer mascot with a microphone and live broadcast branding. Bubbles are amber DNA containment pods with four dinosaur badge families. The HUD calls score `Hype Signal`; successful clears are `Containment Sync`; detached drops are `Floating breach collapsed`; failure is a `Fence Breach`. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art for the jungle, fences, amber storm glow, pod markings, sparks, leaves, and mascot launcher. Keep all gameplay code and styling self-contained in `index.html` when feasible.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first arcade bubble shooter / match-3 cluster clearer
- objective: aim and launch a colored projectile into a hex canopy, clear groups of 3+ matching bubbles, drop disconnected clusters, and keep the canopy from reaching the lower loss rows
- input model: mouse/touch drag on playfield to set an upward-clamped angle, release to fire one projectile; UI buttons use native click/tap
- core loop: start -> seeded grid -> aim -> shoot -> bounce/collide/snap -> match check -> score/drop/fail warning -> spawn next projectile -> repeat
- fail/friction state: non-matching landings add clutter; landing at row `GRID_ROWS - 2` triggers game over; empty grid immediately starts a fresh board

## Protected Mechanics
- 8-column, 12-row hex-grid geometry with odd-row offsets.
- Projectile movement speed relative to tile size, wall bounce, ceiling snap, and circular collision with existing pods.
- BFS same-type matching with threshold 3, roof-connected cluster retention, and floating cluster drops.
- Score semantics: 10 points per matched pod and 20 points per dropped floating pod.
- Start, game-over, restart, mute, and mobile touch/click action paths.

## Remix Trajectory
The new game is `RaptorCam: Amber Panic`, a dramatic Jurassic-inspired live-stream containment broadcast centered on RexByte, a streamer mascot raptor. The exact bubble-shooter loop is reinterpreted as firing DNA flares into a suspended amber pod canopy to synchronize containment and prevent a paddock breach.
